name: paste-plain
desc: Free, open-source paste as plain text tool for Windows — universal hotkey strips formatting from any copy. 100 MB portable, MIT.
features: ✅ **Universal plain paste** — Win+Alt+V pastes clipboard text without fonts, colors or links in any app
✅ **Auto-clean mode** — optionally converts every copy so plain text is the default behavior
✅ **Smart whitespace** — options to collapse blank lines and trim trailing spaces on paste
✅ **Rich-when-wanted exception list** — sender targets like editors can keep original formatting
✅ **No clipboard daemon** — runs in the tray, uses no history database, stores nothing
✅ **Works everywhere** — any control that accepts text, including remote sessions
✅ **100 MB self-contained exe** — runtime bundled, portable, offline, MIT with SHA-256 releases

| Works in every app | **Yes** | Yes | Partial | App-dependent |

faqQ: how to always paste as plain text on Windows?
faqA: Ctrl+Shift+V exists only in some apps, so formatting keeps riding into tickets, emails and code fields. paste-plain binds a system-wide hotkey that pastes cleaned text into any control, or can auto-clean everything you copy. It stores no clipboard history at all and is a 100 MB portable exe under MIT.
